subject: VitalityHealth post-call: decision ladder & SLA/discount exception request
messages:
From: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@vitalityhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@vitalityhealth.com>, procurement@vitalityhealth.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: VitalityHealth — post-demo recap & buying path

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and three asks so we can move this through procurement: 

Decision context and criteria
- Primary use case: clinical summarization for patient intake; must preserve PHI controls and auditability.
- Key requirements: SOC2 (or equivalent), region/data residency controls (US), defined RTO/RPO for inference SLA, and predictable per-token economics.
- Timeline: target pilot start in Jan; procurement + security due diligence in December.

Stakeholders (as discussed)
- Raj Patel — CFO (economic buyer)
- Linda Gomez — Director, InfoSec (security reviewer; not on this thread)
- Procurement mailbox (procurement@vitalityhealth.com) — purchase orders and contracts

Three asks from procurement/security to proceed:
1) Can Redwood provide a draft SOW and a pilot pricing table (3-month, 10k monthly tokens estimate)?
2) Confirmation on SOC2 evidence and SOC report; any third-party audit docs?
3) Can Redwood accept a temporary SLA variance for pilot (we want RTO 4 hours) and what exceptions/credits would apply if you grant that?

I've attached the RFP snippet we shared internally (RFP-VitalityHealth-20261118.pdf). If you can share an initial SOW and a pricing matrix, I'll route to procurement + Raj for review.

Thanks,
Emma Johnson
Head of Clinical Products
VitalityHealth

Attachment: RFP-VitalityHealth-20261118.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: VitalityHealth — post-demo recap & buying path

Team — forwarding Emma's recap. Key asks condensed below and suggested internal plan. Please review before I respond to Vitality.

Quick summary of asks from VitalityHealth:
- Draft SOW + pilot pricing (3 months; est 10k tokens/month)
- SOC2 evidence / attestation; answers on third-party audits
- Temporary SLA variance: RTO 4 hours for pilot; they want to understand exception terms and potential credits

My read on stakeholders: Raj (CFO) is the econ buyer; Linda (InfoSec) drives security gating; procurement will own contract review. They want a fast pilot in Jan, so procurement timeline is tight.

Recommended internal path:
1) Security check (Laura) — confirm whether we can provide SOC2 attestation and a short list of controls they will test. Also identify any non-starters (Linda-level asks).
2) Product/OPS (Marissa) — can we support a 4-hour RTO for a limited pilot? If not exactly, what mitigations: dedicated burst capacity, failover region, or a written escalation SLA?
3) Commercial (Ben) — pricing & credit plan if we make an SLA exception for pilot. Suggest we offer a capped SLA variance (pilot window only) + 10% pilot credit if we miss RTO more than twice. Need to surface the discount threshold with finance.
4) Legal (I'll loop once we have draft SOW/terms).

Attachments for internal: internal-eval-checklist.pdf (short checklist with security/commercial questions).

Next steps I'd like to propose to Vitality (once you all sign off):
- Send them a 1-page pilot SOW + pricing matrix by EOD Fri
- Offer a formal path for SLA exception: pilot-specific SLA with measured credits, subject to sign-off by Legal/Product/Finance
- Ask procurement for their PO timeline and preferred contracting cadence (SOW + PO or full MSA)

If you can each reply with a line item (green/amber/red) on your area by EOD Thu, I'll consolidate and send to Emma.

Thanks — Priyom

Attachment: internal-eval-checklist.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: VitalityHealth — post-demo recap & buying path

+1 on Priyom's plan. Quick commercial input below.

Pricing & commercial guardrails:
- For a 3-month pilot at estimated 10k tokens/month we can offer: list price with a pilot credit of 15% off invoice for month 1 if they commit to a 12-month follow-on at pilot end.
- For SLA exception (RTO 4 hours): recommend we offer a bounded pilot SLA variation for the pilot window only. If we accept the variation we should require:
  * Commitment to a minimum monthly spend (to make burst capacity allocation sensible) — propose $6k/mo minimum for pilot
  * A defined incident escalation path (on-call contact + 2-hour acknowledgement target)
  * A credit schedule: 10% credit for any SLA breach beyond grace allowance, capped at pilot month invoice.

Questions I need answered to finalize pricing:
- Exact token mix (generation vs embeddings) and expected peak concurrency
- Whether they will route PHI data through hosted or private deployment (private will materially change pricing)

I've attached a stamped pricing draft (pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx). If Product (Marissa) confirms the pilot SLA is operationally feasible, I can prep the commercial summary to send to Emma.

Ben
Senior Account Exec
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emma Johnson <emma.johnson@vitalityhealth.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@vitalityhealth.com>, procurement@vitalityhealth.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VitalityHealth — post-demo recap & buying path

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear recap and the RFP. Looping in a few folks from our side and outlining how we propose to proceed so procurement has a concrete set of artifacts to review.

What we are sending you now (attached):
- RDW-SOW-draft-v1.pdf — a short pilot SOW (3 months) that scopes the deliverables, success criteria, and trial metrics.
- pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx — pilot pricing with a conditional credit and a follow-on commitment option.

Commercial summary (short):
- Pilot: 3 months, estimated 10k tokens/month. Pilot pricing is list, with a 15% month-1 credit applied if Vitality signs a 12-month follow-on within 30 days of pilot end.
- Pilot SLA: we can offer a pilot-specific SLA variation (RTO target 4 hours) under the following conditions: minimum monthly pilot spend of $6k, defined escalation contact, and acceptance of a capped credit schedule (10% credit for qualifying SLA breaches). This SLA variation is pilot-only and will require legal sign-off in the final SOW.

Security/compliance: Laura will share SOC2 attestation and a short control matrix by EOD Mon. If Vitality requires extra evidence, we can arrange a redacted report review under NDA.

Next steps for Vitality (proposed):
1) Procurement: confirm procurement cadence — do you prefer SOW + PO or MSA + SOW?
2) Raj / CFO: confirm pilot budget and minimum spend comfort ($6k/mo suggested).
3) Linda/InfoSec: if possible, send the top 5 security questions or a short test plan we can run against staging.

If that sounds OK I'll put legal on standby to accept the pilot SOW and route the SLA variation for quick review. Happy to jump on a 20-min call early next week to walk through the SOW.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priom.das@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0147

Attachments: RDW-SOW-draft-v1.pdf, pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx
